spans.s:
द्यो, औस्, f. (considered by native grammarians as
another form of the base 3. दिव्, forming in the
nom. द्यौस्, as गौस् fr. गो, and used in a few
comp.), the sky, heaven, paradise, &c.; see 3. दिव्.
—द्यो-कार, अस्, m. ‘a maker of brightness,’ a
goldsmith (?), a N. applied to some sort of handicraft.
—द्यो-भूमि, इस्, m. ‘moving between heaven and
earth (?),’ a bird; (ई), f. du. heaven and earth.
—द्यो-षद्, त्, m. (fr. द्यो + सद्), ‘sitting in
heaven,’ a deity, a celestial.
—द्यौर्-दा, आस्, आस्, अम्
(द्यौर् for द्यौस्, nom. of द्यो), giving heaven.
—द्यौर्-लोक, अस्, m. (द्यौर् for द्यौस्, nom. of
द्यो), the heavenly world.
—द्यौ-संशित, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. impelled or incited by heaven.

द्योत, अस्, m. light, lustre, brilliance; sunshine;
heat; [cf. ख-द्˚ and चिन्त्य-द्˚.]
द्योत द्योत, द्योतित, &c. See p. 438, cols. 2, 3.

द्योतक, अस्, आ, अम्, shining; illuminating [cf.
ख-द्˚]; making clear, explaining; meaning, signifi-
cant, expressing, expressive of.
—द्योतक-त्व, अम्,
n. the power or faculty of expressing, expressiveness.

द्योतन, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, shining, bright, bril-
liant; illuminating, enlightening [cf. ख-द्˚]; ex-
plaining, meaning; (अस्), m. a lamp; N. of a prince;
(अम्), n. shining; illumination; making manifest,
explaining, showing; sight, seeing.

द्योतनक, अस्, इका, अम्, making manifest, ex-
plaining; (इका), f. explanation.
द्योतनि, इस्, f., Ved. splendor, brightness.

द्योतमान, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, being bright,
brilliant.

द्योतयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, illuminating, enlighten-
ing, irradiating.

द्योतित, अस्, आ, अम्, shone upon, illustrated, illu-
minated, &c., = द्युतित, q. v.
—द्योतित-प्रभ,
अस्, आ, अम्, resplendent.
द्योतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, shining, brilliant, splendid.

द्योतिस्, इस्, n. light, brightness; a star.
—द्योतिर्-
इङ्गण, अस्, m. a shining insect, fire-fly.
—द्योतिष्-
पथ, अस्, m. ‘the path of the stars,’ the upper
part of the sky; (also read ज्योतिष्-पथ.)

द्योत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made clear or expressed
or explained.
